An '''erkush''' was a large, fierce [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] [[Diet/Legends|predator]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kalee/Legends|Kalee]]. Many of the native [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] would [[Hunting/Legends|hunt]] them, in order to carve ceremonial [[Kaleesh mask/Legends|masks]] out of their [[Bone/Legends|bones]]. The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Saes Rrogon]] had such a [[Helmet/Legends|mask]].<ref name="Crosscurrent" />
